scientific_integrity: Proof supplies a planar reflected-walk coupling and explicit separation. Exact rational tests are finite checks, not a substitute for the all-parameter proof. No independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted endpoint-rooted paths with at least two vertices; simultaneous independent fair binary updates and shared known noise 0<epsilon<1. Infinite-observation almost-sure result; no finite-sample rates, interior-rooted graphs, arbitrary trees or varying noise. Independent validation and historical priority remain unperformed.
title: Lag-two endpoint observations strictly order finite path lengths in the synchronous noisy voter model
